manifest.name: dsh-abyss
manifest.description: 深海事务所 (Abyss) — an operations console for DeepSeek Harness agent fleets: every agent is a character at a desk, every line comes from the durable session log, and any past case replays and reports from disk
manifest.author: Zongwei9888

bundle.text:
# dsh-abyss bundle patch: inserted as one profile layer by `dsh plugin add`.
#
# The entry id is what the product's plugin list shows and searches, so it is
# the package name rather than a short internal word.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-abyss
      name: 'dsh-abyss'

readme.text: **把 DeepSeek Harness 的多 agent 运行过程，变成一间看得见的事务所。** 谁在干活、花了多少、卡在哪 —— 全都来自会话日志，一句台词都不是编的。 中文 · [English](README.en.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-abyss) [](LICENSE) [](#测试) ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-abyss && dsh web ``` ---

一个 dsh 会话跑起来之后，你其实看不见里面发生了什么：派了几个子代理、谁在等谁、哪一步失败了、这次花了多少钱。终端里只有一串流式文字，会话结束就散了。

**深海事务所把这些全部画出来**，而且每一个数字、每一句台词都能追回到 `~/.dsh/sessions` 里的那条日志。它不改 dsh 一行代码，装上即用。

| 页签 | 回答什么 | 视角 |
|---|---|---|
| 🧑 **办公室** | 现在谁在场、正在做什么 | 此刻 · 以人为中心 |
| 💬 **时间线** | 发生过什么，按时间从旧到新 | 过程 · 以时间为中心 |
| 📈 **统计** | 花了多少、卡在哪、谁在等 | 汇总 · 以账为中心 |
| 🌿 **组织** | 谁把活派给了谁 | 关系 · 以谱系为中心 |

时间线：派活、发言、汇报、出错，逐条按真实时间排列，长了自动折叠。
统计：成本、令牌、工具调用、失败、重拨、归档、等人时长、历时；下面是每人上下文水位与考勤泳道。

组织：委派谱系从真实的父子会话关系长出来，一眼看清一个案子分给了几个人。

readme.section: 为什么不是又一个桌宠
readme.text:
| 舞台上发生的 | 背后的 dsh 机制 |
|---|---|
| 一位员工 | 一个 agent 的 session |
| 工牌上的岗位 | `subagent/descriptor.label` |
| 他来自哪家公司 | `subagent/descriptor.provider`（`claude-code`/`codex` 是真的别家 agent） |
| 老板递文件夹 | `tool/call subagent`，气泡里是真实任务简述 |
| 便签飞过工位 | `tool/call send_message`，气泡里是真实消息原文 |
| 站在你门口等批准 | `approval/asked` / `approval/decided`，等了多久是算出来的 |
| 干活干砸了 | `tool/result.error` 或结果块的 `isError` |
| 去档案室整理 | `compaction/summary.shadowedTokenCount` |
| 工资表 | `assistant/message.usage` × 可配价目表 |
| 上下文水位 | `usage` ÷ `request/context.contextWindow` |

readme.section: 为什么不是又一个桌宠
readme.text: 因为 dsh 有「模型可见 ⟺ 必落日志」的运行时不变量，**回放同一个案子会重演一模一样的过程**。

需要 DeepSeek Harness 的 web profile（`dsh web` 能跑起来即可）。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-abyss

dsh web ``` 打开 http://127.0.0.1:3080 ，右下角就是事务所的坞。点开即用，**不需要任何配置**。 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-abyss@latest # 升级 dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-abyss # 卸载（重启后生效） ```
从源码安装（包尚未发布到 npm 时用这个） sh git clone https://github.com/Zongwei9888/dsh-abyss.git && cd dsh-abyss npm install && npm run build && npm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-abyss-<版本>.tgz dsh web ```

`dsh plugin add` 走的是 profile 目录下的 pnpm，所以它同样认 profile 里的 `.npmrc`——私有 registry 直接在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/.npmrc` 里配 `registry=` 即可。
</details>

> 面板嵌在产品自己的页面里，数据挂在同一个 origin 下的 `/abyss`，**不开新端口、不做跨域**。

readme.section: 几个不显眼但有用的地方
readme.text:
- **一个会话 = 一间办公室，重启也还在。** 打开一个昨天的会话，面板会从磁盘上的日志把那间办公室重建出来——成员、已收工的临时工、当时的全部戏份。
- **十个会话同时跑也不乱。** 会话树是「案子」，三档范围（本会话 / 本项目 / 全部）随时切；活跃的案子排前面，结束的折叠成一行。
- **导出复盘。** 一键生成 Markdown 报告：成员表、事故清单、完整台词，直接贴进 PR 或周报。
- **过往案子。** 磁盘上的日志就是档案库，几天前跑完的案子照样能回放、能出报告。
- **读不出来就直说。** 某个成员的日志损坏时，报告顶部会写明"有 N 位成员的日志读不出来，下面的数字不含他们"——一份安静地少算了的报告，比没有报告更糟。
- **可拖动、可缩放**，位置和尺寸都记住；双击标题栏放回右下角。

不配也能用。要改就在 profile 的 `cordis.yml` 里：

```yaml
- id: dsh-abyss
  config:
    prices:                 # 工资表，按每 1M token 计
      deepseek-v4-pro: { input: 0.55, output: 2.19, cacheRead: 0.07 }

非法配置在加载时**大声失败**，不会默默忽略。

- 📖 [五分钟上手教程](docs/tutorial.md) —— 从装上到看懂每一个数字
- 🏗 [它是怎么搭的](docs/architecture.md) —— 宿主/浏览器两半、数据端点、事件映射、测试策略
- 📝 [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)

```sh
npm test        # 113 个用例：投影逻辑 + 宿主装配 + 发布的浏览器 bundle
```

浏览器测试跑的是**发布的那个 bundle**（经 DOM 替身驱动），不是逻辑副本——本项目踩过的每一个客户端缺陷（全局被遮蔽、引号未转义、状态只存在 DOM 里、开关反转、文字被套上旋转动画）对"重新实现一遍逻辑"的测试都是不可见的。

关键路径还做过真机联调：真实跑任务、真实并发三个会话、真实触发审批与工具失败，并把插件报出的数字和原始日志逐项对过账。

**Turns a DeepSeek Harness agent fleet into an office you can watch.** Who is working, what it cost, where it is stuck — every number and every line comes from the durable session log. [中文](README.md) · English [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-abyss) [](LICENSE) [](#tests) ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-abyss && dsh web ``` ---

Once a dsh session is running you cannot actually see what happens inside it: how many subagents it hired, who is waiting on whom, which step failed, what the run cost. The terminal shows a stream of text, and when the session ends it is gone.

**Abyss draws all of it** — and every number, every spoken line traces back to a log in `~/.dsh/sessions`. It changes no dsh code; install it and it is there.

| Tab | The question | Lens |
|---|---|---|
| 🧑 **Floor** | who is here and what they are doing right now | the present, by person |
| 💬 **Timeline** | what happened, oldest first | the process, by time |
| 📈 **Stats** | what it cost, where it is stuck, who is waiting | the totals, by account |
| 🌿 **Org** | who handed work to whom | the lineage, by relation |

Timeline: assignments, messages, reports and failures in real time order; long histories fold.
Stats: spend, tokens, tool calls, failures, retries, compactions, time blocked on a human, elapsed — plus per-member context load and attendance lanes.

Org: the delegation tree grown from real parent/child sessions.

readme.section: Why this is not another desktop pet
readme.text:
| On stage | The dsh fact behind it |
|---|---|
| a staff member | one agent's session |
| their job title | `subagent/descriptor.label` |
| which firm they came from | `subagent/descriptor.provider` (`claude-code` / `codex` are **real** other-vendor agents) |
| handing work down | `tool/call subagent` — its arguments are the brief in the bubble |
| a note flying between desks | `tool/call send_message` — its text is the line |
| standing at your door | `approval/asked` / `approval/decided` — the wait is measured |
| a job going wrong | `tool/result.error` or the result block's `isError` |
| filing papers away | `compaction/summary.shadowedTokenCount` |
| the wage on the nameplate | `assistant/message.usage` × a configurable price table |
| context load | `usage` ÷ `request/context.contextWindow` |

readme.section: Why this is not another desktop pet
readme.text: Because dsh enforces *model-visible ⟺ logged*, **replaying a case replays exactly what happened**.

Requires a DeepSeek Harness web profile (anything where `dsh web` runs).

```sh

readme.section: 1. add it to the web profile
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-abyss

dsh web
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:3080 — the dock sits in the bottom-right corner. **No configuration needed.**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-abyss@latest   # upgrade
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-abyss       # uninstall (takes effect on restart)
```

Install from source (before the package is on npm) sh git clone https://github.com/Zongwei9888/dsh-abyss.git && cd dsh-abyss npm install && npm run build && npm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-abyss-.tgz dsh web ``` `dsh plugin add` runs pnpm inside the profile directory, so it honours that directory's `.npmrc` — point a private registry at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/.npmrc` with `registry=`.
> The panel is embedded in the product's own page and its data is served on the same origin under `/abyss` — **no second port, no cross-origin allowance**.

- **A session is an office, and it survives a restart.** Open yesterday's session and the panel rebuilds that office from the logs on disk — staff, the temps that clocked off, and their scenes.
- **Ten concurrent sessions stay legible.** A session tree is a *case*; three scopes (this case / this project / all) switch instantly, live cases lead, finished ones fold to one line.
- **Export a write-up.** One click produces Markdown: staff table, incident list, full transcript — ready for a PR or a weekly report.
- **Past cases.** The logs on disk are the archive; a case that ended days ago still replays and reports.
- **It says when it cannot read something.** If a member's log is corrupt the report states it up front — totals that are quietly too small are worse than no report.
- **Draggable and resizable**, both remembered; double-click the header to send it back to its corner.

None required. To change anything, edit the profile's `cordis.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-abyss
  config:
    prices:                  # per 1M tokens
      deepseek-v4-pro: { input: 0.55, output: 2.19, cacheRead: 0.07 }

Invalid configuration **fails loudly** at load rather than being ignored.

- 📖 [Five-minute tutorial](docs/tutorial.en.md)
- 🏗 [How it is put together](docs/architecture.en.md) — host/browser halves, endpoints, event mapping, testing
- 📝 [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

```sh
npm test        # 113 cases: projection + host wiring + the shipped browser bundle
```

The browser tests drive the **shipped bundle** through a DOM stand-in rather than a copy of its logic — every client defect this project has hit (a shadowed global, an unescaped quote, state held only in the DOM, an inverted toggle, a motion class landing on text) is invisible to a test that reimplements the code.

Critical paths were also driven against the real product: real tasks, three real concurrent sessions, a real approval escalation and real tool failures, with the plugin's numbers reconciled line by line against the raw logs.
